summary.intent: Use the GSD manager to discuss and plan the remaining 5 hardening-block phases (51–55) of the CipherBox v1.1 milestone, parallelizing planning agents across isolated git worktrees while continuing discussions inline.
summary.outcome: Phases 51–54 fully discussed with CONTEXT.md + DISCUSSION-LOG.md committed on their respective branches; three concurrent planning agents launched in isolated worktrees (p51, p52, p53). Phase 55 not yet discussed. Agents for 51/52/53 were actively committing when the transcript ended.

repo: The GSD dep parser splits 'Phase 49 **(v1.1 baseline)**' into deps `49` + a phantom `1.1`, causing all phases 51–55 to read `deps_satisfied: false` and `recommended_actions` to return empty even though they are fully unblocked.
Phase 50 held a stale `is_active: true` / `roadmap_complete: false` in the init query despite being completed on 2026-06-19; the authoritative source is ROADMAP.md, not the query cache.
The GSD commit helper auto-switches the working tree's branch on the first phase commit (main → feat/<slug>), which can silently yank a branch out from under a concurrently running background agent.
GSD commit helper can return `commit_failed` as a false negative — the commit actually lands; always verify with `git log`.
Desktop E2E `.mjs` helpers bypass tsc/eslint entirely; contract drift is only caught deep in single-OS CI runs (confirmed on #488→#495 for edit-filepointer.mjs and #509 for the IPNS-sequence helper).

Phase 51 scope: Todo #15 (Faro logger redaction + transport) dropped — without a remote transport the redaction interceptor only protects the local browser console and its acceptance criteria require Faro to verify, so it belongs in a future observability phase.

Phase 53 scope: Todo #16 stale-pin clearing dropped — the root cause was a force-push orphaning the bot commit combined with `cancel-in-progress` killing the recompute; fixing recompute reliability makes pin-clearing a band-aid for a symptom, not the actual fix.

The `core.hooksPath` in git config is an absolute path pointing to the main tree's `.husky` directory, so all worktrees run the same pre-commit hooks and require their own `node_modules` (or equivalent) for `pnpm lint-staged` to succeed.

code.finding: Phase 51 todos (#15 Faro/logging, HARD-02 IPNS S1/S2/S3) live here; initial CONTEXT.md had a stale path reference that needed correction before planning.
One of 7 untyped .mjs E2E helpers (Phase 54 scope); broke on PR #509 because it imports from ../dist without type checking.
Broke on #488→#495 due to SDK contract drift not caught by tsc/eslint; part of Phase 54's 7-file migration.

workflow: Background agents on Claude Code DO support nested subagents when the agent registry grants `Tools: *` — the manager workflow's blanket 'no nesting in background on Claude Code' guardrail is stale and overly conservative.

Parallel planning agents require isolated git worktrees; without isolation the GSD commit helper's auto-branch-switch will clobber a running agent's branch and git index.lock collisions become likely.
Worktree isolation pattern: checkout main tree to `main`, create worktree on the phase's feature branch, run `pnpm i` inside the worktree (not a symlink) so husky/lint-staged run cleanly.

Session usage limits can interrupt background agents mid-run; agents are safely restartable if the worktree is clean — check `git log` in the worktree to confirm what (if anything) landed before the interruption.
When three planning agents are running in parallel worktrees, the main tree should stay on `main` between discuss sessions so the next phase's auto-branch fires off the correct base commit.

friction: GSD dep parser bug: parenthetical version suffix in phase title ('Phase 49 **(v1.1 baseline)**') creates a phantom `1.1` dep, blocking the recommendation engine for all dependent phases.
Phase 51 planning agent initially launched without worktree isolation (`isolation` param omitted), requiring a stop-revert-recreate cycle to avoid branch collision with Phase 52's context commit.
Session usage limit hit at ~20:40 Berlin, interrupting the Phase 51 planner after only ~31 seconds (8 tool calls); required detection, state inspection, and manual restart.
Worktrees have no `node_modules`, causing husky pre-commit hooks to fail; a symlink was tried and then removed in favor of `pnpm i` per worktree.
GSD `phase complete` false-negative on commit: reported failure but commit landed — verified via `git log` each time.
Stale Phase 50 `is_active` flag in init query misreports milestone progress (35 vs 36 complete); required manual cross-check against ROADMAP.md.
